_how_to_edit: Add your own reminders here. Quran: add a reference like "2:286" or a range like "94:5-6" to quran_refs (the English text is filled in automatically). Other quotes: copy any entry in 'quotes' and change it. cat must be one of: hadith, ali, iqbal, rumi, scholar. Only add things you have checked in a trusted book.

quotes.text: Actions are only judged by intentions, and every person will have only what they intended.
There are two blessings in which many people are cheated: good health and free time.
The strong one is not the one who overpowers others in wrestling. The strong one is the one who controls himself when he is angry.
None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
Be in this world as if you were a stranger, or a traveller passing through.
Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.
The deeds most beloved to Allah are those done consistently, even if they are small.
Richness is not having many possessions. True richness is the richness of the soul.
Allah does not look at your appearance or your wealth. He looks at your hearts and your deeds.

How wonderful is the affair of the believer, for all of it is good. If something good happens to him, he is grateful, and that is good for him. If hardship befalls him, he is patient, and that is good for him.
Allah says: I am as My servant thinks of Me, and I am with him when he remembers Me.
The world is a prison for the believer and a paradise for the disbeliever.
Paradise is surrounded by hardships, and the Fire is surrounded by desires.
If the son of Adam had a valley full of gold, he would want a second one. Nothing will fill his mouth except dust, and Allah turns in mercy to whoever repents.
Gentleness is not found in anything except that it beautifies it, and it is not removed from anything except that it disfigures it.
Purity is half of faith.
A good word is charity.
A man said to the Prophet: Advise me. He said: Do not become angry. The man asked again and again, and each time he said: Do not become angry.

Every night, in the last third of the night, our Lord says: Who is calling upon Me, that I may answer him? Who is asking of Me, that I may give him? Who is seeking My forgiveness, that I may forgive him?
Three things follow the dead person: his family, his wealth and his deeds. Two of them return and one remains. His family and wealth return, and his deeds remain with him.
Paradise is closer to any of you than the strap of his sandal, and so is the Fire.
Look at those who have less than you, and do not look at those who have more than you. That is more likely to keep you from belittling the blessings Allah has given you.
The best of you are those who have the best character.
Two phrases are light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale, and beloved to the Most Merciful: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi, SubhanAllahil-Azim.
Hasten to do good deeds before trials come like pieces of a dark night.
Ihsan is to worship Allah as though you see Him, and if you do not see Him, know that He sees you.
The religion is sincerity.
Allah is Beautiful and He loves beauty.
Whoever relieves a believer of a hardship of this world, Allah will relieve him of a hardship on the Day of Resurrection.
Whoever takes a path seeking knowledge, Allah makes easy for him a path to Paradise.
The one who remembers his Lord and the one who does not are like the living and the dead.
Do the good deeds that you are able to keep up, for Allah does not grow weary until you grow weary.
Make things easy and do not make them hard. Give good news and do not drive people away.
Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all matters.
Each of you is a shepherd, and each of you is responsible for his flock.
This world is sweet and green, and Allah has placed you in it as successors to see how you will act.
Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His servant than one of you who finds his lost camel in a barren desert.
In the body there is a piece of flesh. If it is sound, the whole body is sound, and if it is corrupt, the whole body is corrupt. Truly, it is the heart.
Whoever says 'SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi' one hundred times a day, his sins are wiped away, even if they are like the foam of the sea.
Do not look down on any good deed, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.
Charity never decreases wealth, and Allah only increases in honour the one who forgives.
When a person dies, his deeds come to an end except for three: ongoing charity, beneficial knowledge, or a righteous child who prays for him.
The world has turned its back and announced its departure, and the Hereafter has come forward and announced its approach.
Inability is a misfortune, patience is courage, abstinence is wealth, self-restraint is a shield, and the best companion is acceptance of Allah's will.
Live among people in such a way that if you die, they weep for you, and if you live, they long for your company.
The most helpless person is one who cannot make friends, and more helpless still is one who loses the friends he has made.
Opportunity passes by like the clouds, so make use of good opportunities.
The tongue of the wise is behind his heart, and the heart of the fool is behind his tongue.
Patience is of two kinds: patience over what you dislike, and patience against what you desire.
Contentment is wealth that never runs out.
Every breath a person takes is a step towards his death.
Wisdom is the lost property of the believer, so take it, even from the people of hypocrisy.
The worth of every person lies in what he does well.
Let none of you place hope in anyone but his Lord, nor fear anything but his own sins. Let no one be ashamed to say 'I do not know' when he does not know.
There is no wealth like intellect, no loneliness more dreadful than self-admiration, and no nobility like fear of Allah.
Knowledge is better than wealth. Knowledge guards you, while you must guard wealth. Wealth decreases when spent, while knowledge grows when shared.

quotes.original:
Khudi ko kar buland itna ke har taqdeer se pehle
Khuda bande se khud pooche, bata teri raza kya hai
quotes.text: Raise your selfhood so high that before every decree, God Himself asks His servant: tell me, what is your wish?

quotes.original:
Sitaron se aage jahan aur bhi hain
Abhi ishq ke imtihan aur bhi hain
quotes.text: Beyond the stars there are still more worlds. Love has more trials yet to come.

quotes.original:
Tu shaheen hai, parwaz hai kaam tera
Tere samne asman aur bhi hain
quotes.text: You are a falcon; flight is your work. Before you lie still more skies.

quotes.original:
Nahin tera nasheman qasr-e-sultani ke gumbad par
Tu shaheen hai, basera kar paharon ki chatanon par
quotes.text: Your nest is not on the dome of a royal palace. You are a falcon: make your home on the rocks of the mountains.

quotes.original:
Yeh ek sajda jise tu giran samajhta hai
Hazar sajdon se deta hai aadmi ko nijaat
quotes.text: This one prostration that you find so heavy frees a person from a thousand other prostrations.

quotes.original:
Amal se zindagi banti hai jannat bhi jahannam bhi
Yeh khaki apni fitrat mein na noori hai na naari hai
quotes.text: Through deeds, life becomes paradise or hell. This creature of dust, by its nature, is neither of light nor of fire.

quotes.original:
Yaqeen mohkam, amal paiham, mohabbat fateh-e-alam
Jihad-e-zindagani mein hain ye mardon ki shamsheerein
quotes.text: Firm conviction, constant action, love that conquers the world: in the struggle of life, these are the swords of the brave.

quotes.original:
Tere ishq ki inteha chahta hoon
Meri sadgi dekh kya chahta hoon
quotes.text: I long for the very limit of Your love. See my simplicity, what it is I ask for.
Listen to this reed, how it tells a tale, complaining of separations.
Everyone who is left far from his source longs to return to the time when he was united with it.
Burst your chains and be free, O son! How long will you be a slave to silver and gold?
The eye of the greedy is never filled. Until the oyster is content, it is not filled with pearls.
Sell your cleverness and buy bewilderment.
There is one thing in this world that must never be forgotten. Forget everything else and you need not worry; but remember everything else and forget that one thing, and you have done nothing at all.
